A machine learning pipeline for detecting and classifying prompt injection attacks using NLP, TF-IDF vectorization, and Linear SVM. The project includes a custom synthetic benchmark dataset, exploratory data analysis, model evaluation, and interactive prompt classification.
Living aggregated LLM red-team corpus + cross-framework taxonomy (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001, KISA). CC-BY-4.0 (data) + MIT (code). Quarterly refresh.
A curated list of LLM/MLLM guardrails, safety benchmarks, guard models, jailbreak attacks, moderation datasets, and evaluation tools.
LLM jailbreak defense research: dataset compilation from 6 academic sources + RefusalLogitsProcessor for logit-biased refusal steering

This project implements a controlled LLM safety evaluation pipeline that measures how different target models respond to adversarial prompt patterns. The system separates the experiment into five layers: dataset curation, prompt generation, target-model execution, automated safety evaluation, and analytics.
Awesome-Jailbreak-on-LLMs is a collection of state-of-the-art, novel, exciting jailbreak methods on LLMs. It contains papers, codes, datasets, evaluations, and analyses.
Grade 7-8 vocabulary-locked writing tutor (Qwen3 4B + 0.6B). Trained from data to hold its reading level under adversarial pushback, where prompting caves. Dataset, eval harness, CI gate.
